title: User-data sunset orchestration and attestable evidence artifacts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build an automated "sunset" pipeline that orchestrates tenant- and region-scoped data retention expirations into attestable evidence artifacts. The pipeline should: 1) detect records that reach end-of-retention according to residency and tenant policies, 2) transition data through configurable stages (quarantine, anonymize, purge) with audit-safe state changes, 3) produce signed evidence bundles (JSON + checksums + signature) that customers and auditors can consume, and 4) expose deterministic verification APIs and a downloadable audit package per request. This ticket covers product requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and coordination with Eng/SEC/Legal for the underlying orchestration and proof formats.
acceptance_criteria: System marks candidate records based on residency-aware retention windows and moves them to 'sunset.quarantine' state
Configurable staged actions exist: quarantine -> anonymize (soft-redact) -> full purge; each stage emits an audit event
Evidence bundle format defined and implemented: includes action timeline, record digests, region tag, responsible service instance, and cryptographic signature
Customers can request a downloadable evidence bundle for a deletion event via Console or API within 30 days of action
Verification endpoint returns canonical proof for a deletion action and validates signature/checksums
SLA: customer-initiated RTBF requests receive confirmation of scheduling within 1 business day and completion within tenant SLA (configurable)
End-to-end e2e tests and regression suites for retention policy changes are added to CI and pass in staging
Security review completed and HSM/KMS integration validated for signing keys

qa_plan: Create synthetic tenant with mixed residency (EU, US, APAC) and variable retention windows
Run retention scanner nightly in staging, validate state transitions and emitted audit events
Verify evidence bundle contains expected digests and signatures and fails validation when tampered
Load test retention scanner on 10M record dataset to ensure completion within SLA bounds
Penetration test for evidence download endpoint and signed bundle handling
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): enable for internal test tenants only; collect metrics and iterate (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (beta): opt-in for select customers with dedicated support; provide manual verification sessions (4 weeks)
Phase 3 (general): enable as configurable retention action in Console with default off for legacy tenants; provide migration path
Rollback: rehydrate quarantined items from immutable snapshot if evidence validation or signing system fails
audit_evidence_schema: action_timeline: ordered list of {action, timestamp, actor, node_id}
record_digest: SHA256 per record or per partition
verification_endpoints: GET /api/v1/compliance/evidence/{bundle_id} - returns signed bundle metadata and download URL
POST /api/v1/compliance/evidence/verify - accepts bundle and returns validation result and canonical action_timeline
GET /console/tenants/{tenant}/retention/audit - UI page listing recent sunset events with 'download evidence' action
